text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from grabbing a quick cup 
of tea with Tucker Brine...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Oh, I was just thinking about buying that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the other end of her gaze was a tiny, 
one-booth shop flying a flashy banner that 
read '1st Prize: 700 Million Yen!'
choice_data_list: Do you buy Dream Lottery tickets often?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I buy the big ones every season! 
Year-end, summer... Honestly, it's become 
a seasonal tradition for me.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The Dream Lottery is the best! After all, 
it's packed with dreams!! Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like an unexpected hobby at 
first... but aiming to hit it big and 
strike it rich is wildly fitting for 
her...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So, with that said, Trainer—mind if I drop 
by for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her joyful expression got me 
feeling excited too. Since we're here 
anyway...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll try buying one too!
Yes, I'll try buying one too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. For this one, I'll go big on 
sequential numbers like usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This week's hot ticket! Pick your numbers 
with 'Lotto 7'! There's a massive 
carryover on the line!
choice_data_list: Ooh! Which number should I pick~♪

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's first check the past winning 
counts and prize amounts from this lottery 
stand.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
There's a chart covering 50 whole years! 
We've gotta check out the trends and 
correlations between dates and days of the 
week too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! This lottery has a long history. 
With such a vast amount of data 
accumulated, why shouldn't we put it to 
good use?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hah, piece of cake! I can pull it up right 
away! I collect data on a daily basis, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The secret to the Dream Lottery lies in 
statistics! You must analyze it from every 
single angle!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, we can jack our winning 
odds sky-highhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was just going to write down my birthday 
or favorite numbers, but... I'm impressed! 
So this is what it looks like when you're 
truly aiming to seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
All right! That oughta do it! I can't wait 
for drawing day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt a fiery momentum behind her words. 
Somehow, I started to believe we might 
actually win. Dreams began to swell...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Should I buy those technical books I gave 
up on because they were too expensive? 
Taking a trip to visit overseas racetracks 
sounds nice too. And I definitely want to 
buy a present for my trainee Umamusume...!
choice_data_list: What would you do if you won, Tucker?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: What if we win? Well, obviously――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
First, asset management!! With fixed 
deposits and bonds, the risk of losing 
principal is low. You can dive right in 
with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
In the future, when I become even 
stronger, these will surely turn into a 
massive fortune! All to make my ideals a 
reality!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Buy a brand new island if you want! Or 
build an enormous training facility, that 
works too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I feel ashamed of getting carried away. 
She heads straight toward her grand dream. 
And on top of that, her methods are 
completely sound—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: S-Solid... you say?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, no! What are you saying?! M-Me, 
dependable and steady...?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't trying to nickel-and-dime it, 
honest...! I mean, I'm glad you're 
praising me... B-But still...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaahhh! *Aheeeem*!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! We need to use it with far more 
bravado! Following pure instinct!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... even after leaving the downtown 
area, Tucker Brine continued pondering how 
to use it.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
――If so! Then let us build a racetrack for 
merely a few hundred million! How about a 
rough dirt course brimming with wild 
nature?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Once it's built, running costs will 
probably be an issue, but as for that...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
If only we could bolster our on-site 
facilities with year-round demand to 
secure a steady source of revenue……!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
That's why we can do it! We'll build it! 
With a bang! Yes, with a bang, exactly as 
our instincts demand...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when Tucker Brine lets her heart 
wander into grand dreams, she can never 
quite shake off the pragmatic realities in 
the back of her mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A wild spirit paired with steadfast 
prudence. That hybrid charm struck me as 
fascinating—and deeply reliable.
